description_it: Crostini croccanti di pane integrale tostato, ideali come accompagnamento per zuppe e insalate.
description_en: Crispy whole wheat toasted croutons, ideal as a side for soups and salads.
steps_it: Tagliare il pane integrale a cubetti.
Tostare in forno a 180°C per 10 minuti fino a doratura.
steps_en: Cut whole wheat bread into cubes.
Toast in oven at 180°C for 10 minutes until golden.
